wire.notification_sound.cli.add.help: Add your own sound from a file or an attachment digest
wire.notification_sound.cli.add.keep_lou: Keep the file's own loudness instead of matching the built-in sounds
wire.notification_sound.cli.add.select.h: Use it as the notification sound right away

wire.notification_sound.cli.doctor.help: Explain what plays when a notification fires, and how to stop a double sound
wire.notification_sound.cli.help: List, preview and check notification sounds
wire.notification_sound.cli.list.help: List the built-in sounds and show which one is selected
wire.notification_sound.cli.preview.help: Play a sound now at the configured volume
wire.notification_sound.cli.preview.volu: Volume from 0 to 100 for this preview only (default: the configured volume)
wire.notification_sound.cli.remove.help: Delete one of your sounds from this computer
wire.notification_sound.cli.remove.id.he: Custom sound id, from `lop sound list`
wire.notification_sound.cli.rename.id.he: Custom sound id, from `lop sound list`
wire.notification_sound.description: The sound played with a desktop notification. It plays only when a banner is shown, at most once every 1.5 seconds on this computer. Try one with `lop sound preview <id>`.
wire.notification_sound.enabled.help: Plays with each desktop notification. Off keeps banners silent wherever Local Operator controls their sound.
wire.notification_sound.enabled.label: Play a sound
wire.notification_sound.error.attachment: No attachment {digest} was found in this computer's attachment store.
wire.notification_sound.error.builtin_re: {id} is a built-in sound. Only sounds you added can be renamed or removed.
wire.notification_sound.error.limit_reac: You have {limit} sounds, the most allowed. Remove one to add another.
wire.notification_sound.error.not_found: There is no custom sound called {id}. Run `lop sound list` to see your sounds.
wire.notification_sound.error.silent: {file} is silent, so there is nothing to play. Choose another file.
wire.notification_sound.error.store_fail: The sound could not be saved. Free some space on the volume holding {where} if it is full, and check that {where} is writable, then try again.
wire.notification_sound.error.too_large: {file} is over {limit_mb} MB. Choose a shorter clip.
wire.notification_sound.error.too_long: {file} is {seconds} seconds long. Sounds can be up to {limit} seconds.
wire.notification_sound.error.undecodabl: Couldn't read {file}. It may be damaged or not an audio file.
wire.notification_sound.error.unsupporte: Opus and M4A files can't be read. Convert {file} to WAV or FLAC, then add it again.
{file} isn't WAV, FLAC, MP3 or OGG. Convert it to WAV or FLAC, then add it again.
wire.notification_sound.id.choice.system: terminal or system default; Local Operator plays nothing
wire.notification_sound.id.help: A built-in sound, one of yours (add them with `lop sound add`), or `system` to keep your terminal's or system's own sound. Hearing two sounds? Run `lop sound doctor`.
wire.notification_sound.id.label: Sound
wire.notification_sound.removed.selectio: Your selected sound was removed; {default} is selected again.
wire.notification_sound.title: Notification sound
wire.notification_sound.volume.help: 0–100; default 70. 0 is silent. Sets this sound only; your system volume still applies.
wire.notification_sound.volume.label: Volume
